text:
2 Meaning of “psychoactive substance” etc

(1) In this Act “psychoactive substance” means any substance which—
(a) is capable of producing a psychoactive effect in a person who consumes it, and
(b) is not an exempted substance (see section 3).

(2) For the purposes of this Act a substance produces a psychoactive effect in a person if,
by stimulating or depressing the person's central nervous system, it affects the person's
mental functioning or emotional state; and references to a substance's psychoactive
effects are to be read accordingly.

(3) For the purposes of this Act a person consumes a substance if the person causes or
allows the substance, or fumes given off by the substance, to enter the person's body
in any way.
